title: Numbering series
description: The formats of record numbers. A subject can have several series (invoices, quotes…); a new record takes the default one, or the one picked on its form. Numbers already given never change.
subject: Records
none: No series yet. Records are numbered by the format in code.
deleteDescription: New {{subject}} records can no longer take this series. Numbers already given stay as they are.
inCodeTitle: Numbered by the format in code
inCodeHint: These records have no series yet; they use the format below until the first series is created.

form.syntax: Write the pattern in parts between dots: text, YYYY, YY, MM, DD, JJJ or WW for the date, {field} for a field of the record, FY or ABBR for the company's values, and one run of # for the counter (zero padded). Example: INV-.YYYY.-.MM.-.#####
form.subject: Records
form.patternTooLong: The pattern is at most 60 characters.
form.patternHint: Exactly one run of #, such as #####.
form.patternTaken: {{subject}} already has a series with the pattern “{{pattern}}”.
form.previewEmpty: Type a pattern to see the next number.
form.label: Label
form.labelHint: Optional. Shown where a series is picked.
form.labelTooLong: The label is at most 100 characters.
form.makeDefault: Make it the default for these records
form.partsHint: Click a part to add it to the pattern.
form.dateFieldHint: The date parts and FY come from this date of the record; a record without it uses the moment it is created.
form.conditionsHint: Optional. A new record takes this series when all conditions hold for it; the first by priority wins.
form.priorityHint: Higher first, among the series whose conditions hold.

counter.title: Counter
counter.description: The counter of “{{pattern}}” for the current period.
counter.hint: The next record gets this value plus one. It cannot go below the last value taken.
counter.invalid: Enter a whole number, zero or more.
counter.tooLow: The counter cannot go below the last value taken ({{current}}).
counter.valuesHint: This pattern counts per value of {{fields}}. Enter the values whose counter you want.
counter.valuesRequired: Enter a value for every field.
